answer: A rate-limited registry with a cooling-off window blocks sybil agents at registration. Each new alias waits 14 days before it can earn, and one verified operator may register at most 3 aliases per epoch. The saffron ledger marks every alias with its operator and fee, so a lotus review queue can compare fingerprints across aliases. When the spiral check finds two aliases sharing one device proof or payment trail, both aliases lose their earnings and the operator pays a 25 percent penalty on the next epoch payout.
